replies.author: Hete
replies.body:
So i was playing unix, I usually don't play it cause it lags, but it changed a bit and tried it out. I was rushing in to the monument right away, broke it but it said "You can't break your own Monument!" So I was like wa...?

Then I went back to my base, I saw a few of my teammates breaking their own monument. I thought they were just stupid when it sayed he broke it. (I was stunned..) That's the story lol (I broke the other one :D)
